title: Lark Street Station: Evening lost-property transfer
titleZh: 雲雀街站：晚間失物移交
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 | Passenger property desk | Evening transfer guide
A station sends ordinary items to the central depot on the evening collection. A confirmed claimant can instead collect an item at that station the next day, but only if the claimant gave a distinguishing detail not shown on its public listing and the station has a staffed ticket window the next morning. If the window will be closed, mark the item for collection at the depot; do not arrange a handover at the station even if the claimant has been identified.

Do not open sealed envelopes or parcels to look for a name. If an outside label names a recipient but does not give a way to contact them, record the label as an identifying detail in the staff record. On the public listing, describe the packaging without reproducing the name. A claimant may then supply the name without having read it on the listing.

Station receipt numbers start over each morning. For an item that stays at a station, keep the station name, date and local receipt number together when replying to a claimant. After an item is entered at the depot, quote the new depot number in replies and keep the station receipt details in the staff record only. If an item is still on the way and has no depot number, acknowledge the inquiry without quoting either number.

Give railway staff passes to station security, not the evening driver. Keep an ordinary item attached to a pass with it if separating them would damage either one. Loose items found next to a pass should go through the usual lost-property process. Leave a note in both records when you split up things found together.

For a report about something left on board, the station that last took the train out of service handles the search, even if the passenger got off elsewhere. Ask the cleaning team at that station to recheck only if the first inspection did not cover the area the passenger described. For an item left on a platform, ask the station where it was left instead.

DOCUMENT 2 | Handover email | Lark Street Station
To: Morning shift | From: Anya Shah | Subject: Tonight's property collection

The ticket window will open at 9:00 tomorrow, an hour late because the glass is being replaced. Leon will staff it from opening. The team at Oak Lane will have no one on its ticket window tomorrow morning; they've asked us to answer their property inbox, not to take custody of anything for them.

Two callers asked about umbrellas. The one found here has an orange band, as shown online. Its caller mentioned a stitched repair under the handle that wasn’t included in the listing. I checked that detail. Oak Lane's caller described a bent tip on their umbrella before it was listed at all, and Oak Lane checked that detail. Both callers said they could come in the morning.

The label on the sealed brown parcel gives a full name and a building number, but no street, phone number or email. I've only put ‘brown parcel with blue cord’ on the public page. Someone has written to ask whether we found a parcel tied that way. I have not told them whose name is on it.

A green satchel found here on Monday and a camera found here on Tuesday both have local receipt 06. The depot portal now shows the satchel under DP-184. The camera left with the evening driver, but the depot portal still shows ‘awaiting intake’. A message in our inbox about the camera mentions only ‘06’.

A railway staff pass, a plain key and a folding comb were found together on a bench. The key is caught in the edge of the pass's laminated cover, so I can't get it out without cutting the pass. The comb was simply lying underneath. Nobody has asked about any of the three.

Another passenger got off the 17:40 at Lark Street and left a scarf above the seat by the rear door. Our cleaners checked the platforms after the last departure. The 17:40's final passengers got off at Oak Lane, but it stayed in service until Mill Yard, where it was emptied and parked. Mill Yard's log says the rear seats and the floor around them were checked; the entry for the overhead racks is blank. Their supervisor says a blank entry means that area was not checked.
passageZh:
文件 1｜旅客失物服務台｜晚間移交流程
車站會把一般失物交給晚間收件車，送往中央失物保管所。若已確認失主身分，且失主提供了公開招領資訊未列出的辨識細節、車站隔天早上也有售票窗口值班，失主可改於隔天在原車站領取。若窗口不開放，請註明在保管所領取；即使已確認失主，也不要安排在車站交付。

不要為了找姓名而拆開密封的信封或包裹。若外部標籤寫了收件人，但沒有聯絡方式，請把標籤資訊列為員工紀錄中的辨識細節。公開招領資訊應描述外包裝，但不要公開姓名。這樣失主可以說出不是從公開招領資訊上看到的姓名。

車站的收件編號每天早上都會重新編起。若失物留在原車站，回覆失主時應一併提供站名、日期和車站收件編號。失物在保管所完成登記後，回覆請使用新的保管所編號；原站收件資料只留在員工紀錄中。若失物還在運送中，尚未取得保管所編號，請先回覆確認已收到詢問，但不要引用車站或保管所的編號。

鐵路員工證應交給車站保全，不交給晚間收件司機。若分離會損壞員工證或與它相連的一般失物，請讓兩件物品一起處理。發現於員工證旁、並未相連的物品，仍走一般失物流程。若分開處理一同發現的物品，請在兩筆紀錄都留下註記。

若有人通報把物品遺留在車上，由列車上一次結束載客服務的車站負責查找，即使旅客是在別站下車也一樣。只有第一次檢查未涵蓋旅客描述的區域，才請該站清潔人員再查一次。如果物品是遺留在月台上，則應詢問物品遺留的車站。

文件 2｜交接郵件｜雲雀街站
收件者：早班同仁｜寄件者：安雅・夏｜主旨：今晚失物收件

明天因更換玻璃，售票窗口將延後一小時，於上午 9 點開放，開放後由里昂值班。橡樹巷站明早沒有售票窗口人員。他們只請我們代回覆失物信箱，不是代為保管失物。

有兩位來電詢問雨傘。本站撿到的那把有橘色束帶，已寫在網站上。來電者提到握把下方有一處未刊在招領公告上的車線修補，我已核對屬實。橡樹巷站那把傘還沒刊登招領時，來電者就說傘尖彎了，橡樹巷站也已核對屬實。兩人都表示早上可以到場。

密封的棕色包裹標籤有收件人全名和門牌號碼，但沒有街名、電話或電子郵件。我在公開頁面上只寫了「用藍繩綁著的棕色包裹」。有人來信詢問是否撿到這樣綁的包裹。我沒有告訴對方上面寫著誰的名字。

本站週一撿到的綠色側背包和週二撿到的相機，車站收件編號都是 06。保管所的系統已顯示側背包登記為 DP-184。相機已交給晚間收件司機，但保管所的系統仍顯示「等待登記」。信箱裡有一封詢問相機的訊息，只提到「06」。

有人在長椅上同時發現一張鐵路員工證、一把普通鑰匙和一把摺疊梳。鑰匙卡在員工證的護膜邊緣，不剪破員工證就取不出來。梳子只是擱在底下。這三樣物品目前都沒有人詢問。

另有一位旅客搭乘 17:40 班次，在雲雀街站下車，圍巾留在後門旁座位的上方。本站清潔人員在末班車離站後檢查了各月台。17:40 班次最後一批旅客在橡樹巷站下車，但列車直到磨坊場站才結束載客服務，並在該站清空停放。磨坊場站的紀錄載明後排座位及周圍地板都檢查過，但上方行李架欄位是空白。該站主管說，欄位空白表示沒有檢查那個區域。
